channel.title: Independent Journal review - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Independent Journal review (ijr.com)

item.title: EXCLUSIVE: Trump Pulls US Out Of Notoriously ‘Alarmist’ UN Climate Change Panel
item.description: President Donald Trump has signed an executive order (date) officially pulling the U.S. out of a notoriously "alarmist" climate change body that formed the basis for the Paris Climate Accords in the United Nations (UN).

item.title: Ilhan Omar Caught Sneaking Carveout For Somali-Led Group In Congress’ Spending Package
item.description: House appropriators plan to strike Democratic Minnesota Rep. Ilhan Omar's $1 million earmark for a Somali-led organization from the lower chamber's funding package Wednesday, as the presence of the carveout threatened to tank the shutdown-preventing bill.

item.title: Trump Demands Record $1.5 Trillion Defense Spending To Build ‘Dream Military’
item.description: President Donald Trump on Wednesday called for the U.S. defense budget to be increased to $1.5 trillion in fiscal year 2027 to build what he described as a "Dream Military."

item.title: ‘Trump Isn’t Weapons-Grade Stupid’: John Kennedy Thinks He Knows What Trump’s Plans Are For Greenland
item.description: Republican Louisiana Sen. John Kennedy said on Wednesday that he believed President Donald Trump’s administration was pursuing a legal pathway — not a military invasion — to acquire Greenland following a classified briefing.

item.title: Trump Says Venezuela Will Use Oil Money To Buy American Only Made Products
item.description: President Donald J. Trump announced Wednesday that Venezuela will commit revenue from a newly arranged oil deal exclusively toward purchasing American products.

item.title: Woman Fatally Shot By ICE Agent Identified
item.description: The Minneapolis City Council identified the woman killed by a federal agent Wednesday as 37-year-old Renee Nicole Good, CBS News Minnesota reported.

item.title: DAVID BLACKMON: Treat Early Venezuela Cost Estimates With Caution
item.description: Various estimates for the cost of revitalizing Venezuela’s once-powerful oil sector are already rolling out, and the number one caution for news consumers is clear: Pay no attention to the headline number. Instead, dig deep into the details of the report before jumping to any conclusions. A report released Monday by Rystad Energy provides a good example.

item.title: Trump Admin Withdrawing From ‘Anti-American’ Global Climate Change Regimes
item.description: The White House announced Wednesday that the U.S. is exiting 66 international organizations and treaties, including landmark climate change agreements entered in 1992.

item.title: Kristi Noem Says Renee Nicole Good ‘Stalked’ ICE Agents Before Fatal Minneapolis Shooting
item.description: Good was shot and killed on Wednesday after allegedly attempting to ram an ICE agent with her car during a protest in a Minneapolis neighborhood.

item.title: Experts Say Money Likely Drove Alan Jackson’s Exit From Nick Reiner Murder Case
item.description: Defense attorney Seth Zuckerman, who has represented actors Jonathan Majors and Paul Haggis, agreed that finances likely drove the change.
